map.输入观测日期、经纬度与光污染环境，估算月相、月升月落时间及综合观测条件评分，依据: Enter the observation date, longitude and latitude and the light pollution environment to estimate moon phase, moonrise and moonset times and a combined observation conditions score, following IDA dark-sky standards to help astronomy enthusiasts pick ideal observing windows.
map.输入观测日期、经纬度与光污染等级，估算月相、月升月落与综合观测评分。: Enter the observation date, longitude and latitude and the light pollution level to estimate moon phase, moonrise, moonset and a combined observation score.
map.依据 IDA（国际暗空协会）暗空标准，帮助爱好者挑选低光害、无月干扰的窗口。: Based on the IDA (International Dark-Sky Association) dark-sky standards, helping enthusiasts choose windows with low light pollution and no moon interference.
map.在计划深空摄影或流星雨观测时，评估当夜天空质量。: When planning deep-sky photography or meteor shower observation, assess that night's sky quality.
map.示例：郊外 Bortle 4 区、新月前后观测: Example: observing in a suburban Bortle 4 area around the new moon
map.：若当夜月相照明比例低于 10% 且月落早于午夜，配合 Bortle 4（乡村天: If the moon's illuminated fraction is under 10% and it sets before midnight, combined with Bortle 4 (rural sky) you get a high score; in a city at Bortle 8 near a full moon the score drops sharply, so reschedule or switch to planetary imaging.
map.事件视界（r_s = 2·G·M / c²）: Event horizon (r_s = 2 x G x M / c^2)
map.赤纬（δ ≈ 23.44°·sin(360°·(284+N)/365)）: Declination (delta = 23.44 degrees x sin(360 x (284 + N)/365))
map.由 John Bortle 提出的夜空亮度分级，1 为最暗的 pristine: The night sky brightness scale proposed by John Bortle, where 1 is the darkest pristine sky and 9 is a city center; a smaller number suits deep-sky observation better.
map.为什么月亮对观测影响大？: Why does the moon affect observation so much?
map.满月亮度会照亮大气、抬高背景，淹没暗弱星系与星云；无月且远离光害时可见星等最深。: A full moon lights up the atmosphere and raises the background, drowning out faint galaxies and nebulae; with no moon and low light pollution the faintest magnitudes are visible.
